rows.text: Intimation for upgradation in Credit Rating of the Company under SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”)
per its own headline, highest-ever quarterly profit of Rs 87 cr in Q2 FY27, up 151% YoY (filing not read).
Q2 FY27 AUM grows 26% YoY and disbursements 10% (15% QoQ), while gross NPA eases 19 bps to 4.30%.
